n1-a.alt: In the village, the good men sit in the shade of a palm tree, talking kindly with the villagers who come to them; warm afternoon light.
n1-a.scene: In a village of round mud houses with thatched roofs among palm trees and fields, in a wide green valley, three kind, humble old men with deep dark brown skin and grey beards, in plain white tunics sit in the shade of a palm tree, talking kindly with the villagers who come to them; warm afternoon light.

n1-c.alt: the statues stand alone in an empty square at evening, long shadows across the dust, weeds growing at their feet. No people.
n1-c.scene: five tall rough stone statues of standing figures, plain and weathered, their faces worn smooth and blank stand alone in an empty square at evening, long shadows across the dust, weeds growing at their feet. No people.

n1-d.alt: Seen from behind, a crowd of villagers bow down before the statues at dusk, offerings of fruit at the statues' feet; the faces of the people are not seen.
